items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I'm trying to think of some of the, now there was another old time drummer, I don't know if you know of him, Arnold De Pass.

ctx.x: So she gave it up. Is she older than you or? No, she's younger than you. Younger than you. Yeah, she's younger than you. I thought maybe in case she was older, she might have known a good deal about your father too. Some things maybe you would have forgotten. No, she's younger than you. She'd be younger than you. Yeah, she's younger than you. I would have known as well as you. I know.
I'm trying to think of some of the, now there was another old time drummer, I don't know if you know of him, Arnold De Pass.
Oh, yes. You've heard of him? We got a picture of him.
